title: DPWH official links Estrada to P1.6-billion budget insertions in 2025
summary: Sen. Jinggoy Estrada is allegedly involved in over P1.6 billion worth of insertions into the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) budget back in 2025, an official said.
